007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent;
008
009import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
010
011/**
012 * Typed parameters for exporting an agent team definition to a destination.
013 *
014 * <p>{@code overwrite} is the export parameter currently supported by
015 * {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT.EXPORT_TEAM}. A null value omits the optional
016 * database parameter object.</p>
017 *
018 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ExportTeamSample.html">
019 *      ExportTeamSample source</a>
020 * @since 1.1.0
021 */
022public final class ExportTeamParams {
023    /** JSON mapper used to serialize export parameters. */
024    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();
025
026    /** Whether an existing destination may be overwritten. */
027    private final Boolean overwrite;
028
029    private ExportTeamParams(Builder builder) {
030        this.overwrite = builder.overwrite;
031    }
032
033    /**
034     * Creates a builder for export parameters.
035     *
036     * @return mutable builder for export parameters
037     */
038    public static Builder builder() {
039        return new Builder();
040    }
041
042    /**
043     * Returns whether an existing destination should be overwritten.
044     *
045     * @return overwrite setting, or {@code null} when omitted
046     */
047    public Boolean getOverwrite() {
048        return overwrite;
049    }
050
051    /**
052     * Serializes these parameters for the database package.
053     *
054     * @return JSON object containing the supplied parameters, or {@code null}
055     *         when no optional parameter was supplied
056     * @throws IllegalStateException when the parameters cannot be serialized
057     */
058    public String toParamsJson() {
059        if (overwrite == null) {
060            return null;
061        }
062        try {
063            return MAPPER.createObjectNode()
064                    .put("overwrite", overwrite)
065                    .toString();
066        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
067            throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to serialize ExportTeamParams", e);
068        }
069    }
070
071    /** Builder for immutable export parameters. */
072    public static final class Builder {
073        /** Whether an existing destination may be overwritten. */
074        private Boolean overwrite;
075
076        private Builder() {
077        }
078
079        /**
080         * Sets whether an existing destination should be overwritten.
081         *
082         * @param overwrite whether an existing destination may be replaced
083         * @return this builder
084         */
085        public Builder overwrite(Boolean overwrite) {
086            this.overwrite = overwrite;
087            return this;
088        }
089
090        /**
091         * Builds immutable export parameters.
092         *
093         * @return immutable export parameters
094         */
095        public ExportTeamParams build() {
096            return new ExportTeamParams(this);
097        }
098    }
099}
